preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.

The integer K must be between 1 and the length of the string S.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(sorted(S)) if K == 1 else ''.join(sorted(S[i::K]) for i in range(K))
postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest string S' formed by partitioning S into K subsequences and concatenating them.
